method_proposal.method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic recurrent next-token model on the allowed unlabeled SMILES corpus and freeze it as a chemical-language prior. For each independent objective session, grow a fresh Monte Carlo search tree whose nodes are SMILES prefixes: initialize available path statistics from the ten scored starting molecules, select prefixes by an upper-confidence tree rule, expand them with high-probability unseen tokens from the frozen model, and use model rollouts to complete new molecules. Canonicalize locally and submit batches containing only newly constructed, valid, unique terminal SMILES; after each oracle response, backpropagate the observed scores through the visited prefix paths. The dynamically expanded tree therefore converts 290 feedback calls into increasingly focused de novo construction toward high terminal rewards without updating a policy, fitting a latent surrogate, mutating evaluated parent graphs, or ranking a finite corpus pool.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is the de novo molecular graph genetic algorithm because both exploit fragments from evaluated molecules and feed successful offspring back into later proposals. The graph GA proposes by hard-coded stochastic graph crossover and atom, bond, ring, or fragment mutation of selected parent graphs; this lineage instead attaches reward-ranked fragment contexts and samples a replacement fragment from a learned conditional distribution through repeated whole-span masking and bidirectional discrete-diffusion denoising. That proposal mechanism can create a fragment absent from the current vocabulary and uses neither graph crossover nor the GA mutation portfolio. Unlike Augmented Hill-Climb, its frozen denoiser receives no reward-gradient update and generation is non-autoregressive; unlike ChemTS, it has no prefix tree or UCT rollout; unlike COWBOYS, it has no continuous latent search, GP acquisition, or pCN sampler. method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the unguided root succeeds, add only GenMol's molecular context guidance to the reverse-denoising logits while keeping the trained denoiser, fragment scoring, attachment, and remasking loop fixed: contrast the prediction from the intact retained-fragment context with a deliberately weakened-context prediction and extrapolate toward the intact-context result at one task-agnostic guidance strength. GenMol's published goal-directed ablation improves its 23-task PMO sum from 18.208 for attachment plus fragment remasking to 18.362 with this guidance and reports the guided version best on 19 of 23 tasks. Although that evidence uses PMO AUC Top-10 rather than this campaign's terminal Top-1, it supports the causal direction that stronger use of high-reward retained context can make each de novo replacement more productive; the campaign score remains the decision criterion.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic bidirectional masked discrete-diffusion model on SAFE fragment sequences from the allowed unlabeled corpus, then keep its weights frozen during every objective session. Initialize a dynamic fragment vocabulary only from oracle-evaluated molecules, score each fragment by the observed rewards of molecules containing it, and construct each new starting context by sampling and attaching high-scoring fragments. Replace one complete fragment span with mask tokens and iteratively denoise that span in parallel while conditioning on the retained fragments; canonicalize locally and submit only newly generated valid unique molecules. Oracle feedback updates fragment scores and admits fragments from evaluated offspring, so the generator can repeatedly refine promising chemistry while its learned conditional denoising can synthesize fragments outside the current vocabulary. Every candidate is therefore generated de novo rather than retrieved or ranked from the corpus, and reward-directed fragment regeneration targets improvement of the final Top-1 within the sparse feedback budget.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is the de novo molecular graph genetic algorithm because both construct offspring by editing evaluated molecular graphs. The graph GA globally applies rank-biased parent selection, two-parent crossover, mutation, and elitist population replacement; this lineage instead preserves ten chain identities, proposes a single reversible add/delete transition from each current state, and applies a local Metropolis-Hastings decision that can deliberately retain a worse-scoring move early in the annealing schedule. It has no crossover, reproductive ranking, or elitist replacement. It also differs from COWBOYS by using neither a VAE, structure GP, acquisition batch selection, nor latent pCN; from Augmented Hill-Climb by using no autoregressive policy or reward-gradient update; from ChemTS by using no prefix tree, UCT selection, or rollout; and from GenMol by using no learned denoiser or fragment remasking. method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the root succeeds, change only the edit proposal from uniform reversible choices to a MARS-style adaptive proposal: fit a lightweight graph editor by maximum likelihood on previously observed transitions whose candidate beat its chain state, while mixing every learned distribution with the uniform kernel so reverse support and the Metropolis-Hastings correction remain defined. method_proposal.method_thesis: Extract a vocabulary of single-attachment fragments from the allowed unlabeled corpus without scoring or retrieving any whole corpus molecule, and start one persistent molecular-graph Markov chain from each of the ten fixed evaluated molecules. In every feedback round, generate one fresh candidate per chain through a locally sanitized, reversible fragment-add or fragment-delete transition, retrying locally until the batch contains ten novel canonical molecules. After the oracle returns, accept each proposed state with a Metropolis-Hastings probability for an annealed score density, including its forward/reverse proposal ratio; rejected proposals leave their chains at the previous states. Low inverse temperature initially permits controlled downhill moves that can cross structural valleys, while increasing concentration later favors high-score states. Thus all oracle calls evaluate de novo molecular constructions, and feedback directly steers persistent search paths toward a stronger final Top-1 without a surrogate, a learned generator, or finite-library screening.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization because both adapt a pretrained generator with oracle feedback. method_proposal.method_thesis: Learn a task-agnostic forward and backward molecular-construction policy from the allowed unlabeled corpus using an atom-and-fragment graph grammar, then restart that policy independently for each objective. From an empty graph, the forward policy samples chemically valid attachment, bond, and stop actions until it produces a terminal molecule; whole corpus molecules are never retrieved, ranked, or used as a finite candidate pool. After each evaluator-announced batch is scored, map each observed score to a strictly positive tempered terminal reward and train on only oracle-evaluated molecules and their sampled construction/deconstruction trajectories using the trajectory-balance loss, a learned partition function, and reward-prioritized replay. Because trajectory balance assigns terminal probability according to total flow across every construction route rather than merely increasing the likelihood of one elite sequence, online feedback amortizes search into a de novo sampler whose probability mass concentrates on high-reward molecular regions while continuing to expose distinct routes to rare high-scoring structures. The optimization target remains the mean final Top-1 across the five independent sessions; flow statistics and replay usage are mechanism evidence, not substitute objectives.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is SeqFlow-invertible trust-region latent Bayesian optimization because both generate molecules by decoding continuous latent points. SeqFlow fits a latent Gaussian process, centers trust regions on evaluated anchors, and Thompson-selects from an ephemeral pool of perturbed codes; this lineage fits no surrogate and performs no surrogate pre-ranking of an overgenerated pool, but uses CMA-ES feedback ranks to update one persistent Gaussian search distribution and draws the next de novo molecules directly from it. Compared with COWBOYS decoupled structure-space Bayesian generation, it has no fingerprint GP, posterior-probability tilt, preconditioned Crank-Nicolson chain, or expected-improvement selector. Compared with the graph GA and annealed fragment-edit MCMC lineages, it uses neither graph crossover and mutation nor persistent graph chains with Metropolis-Hastings decisions. Compared with Augmented Hill-Climb, the molecular decoder remains frozen and feedback updates a latent search distribution rather than token likelihoods. Compared with ChemTS it has no prefix tree or UCT; compared with GenMol it has no SAFE fragment remasking or reverse diffusion; and compared with the molecular GFlowNet it has no graph-action flow or trajectory-balance loss. It is therefore a different optimization paradigm and proposal mechanism, not an encoder, kernel, or acquisition-constant variation within latent Bayesian optimization. method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the root succeeds, keep the dense autoencoder, rank weights, de novo decoding, and standard CMA-ES step-size rule fixed, and add only CMA-ES-LED's signal-to-noise effective-dimension adaptation: estimate active directions in the current covariance eigenbasis from the mean and rank-mu updates, then compute the covariance learning rates from the estimated rather than nominal latent dimension. Uchida, Yamaguchi, and Shirakawa report that CMA-ES-LED outperforms standard CMA-ES on rotated low-effective-dimensionality benchmark functions. That evidence is cross-domain rather than a 300-call molecular result, so the transfer claim is conditional: if task reward varies along only a few coordinated molecular-latent directions, faster covariance learning across the limited feedback rounds should increase the chance of a stronger terminal Top-1; the estimated effective dimension is activation evidence, not a substitute objective.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic MolMIM-style probabilistic SMILES autoencoder only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, using variance-conditioned latent training so local perturbations remain decodable, and then freeze it. In each independent objective session, encode the fixed evaluated starting molecules, center a CMA-ES search distribution on the best observed latent, and repeat an ask/tell loop: sample a fresh latent population from the current multivariate Gaussian, decode each point de novo, canonicalize and locally replace invalid or previously seen molecules, submit only the newly decoded batch, and update the Gaussian mean, covariance, and global step size from the returned score ranks. The method neither fits a surrogate nor screens the corpus; oracle feedback changes the continuous proposal distribution directly, so coordinated latent directions that repeatedly yield better molecules receive more probability during the 290 adaptive calls. The sole success target is the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

MolMIM's CMA-ES forgets individual trajectories and asks from one rank-adapted multivariate Gaussian whose mean, covariance, and step size are population parameters; this lineage preserves particle identity, velocity, and personal-best memory and asks by moving each particle toward explicit personal and social exemplars, with no learned covariance distribution or rank-weighted Gaussian sampling. It differs from the bound SeqFlow and COWBOYS lineages by fitting no GP and using no trust region, Thompson acquisition, posterior tilt, or latent MCMC; from Augmented Hill-Climb and the molecular GFlowNet by applying no reward update to generator weights and no trajectory-balance loss; from the graph GA and annealed fragment-edit sampler by using neither graph crossover/mutation nor Metropolis-Hastings transitions; from ChemTS by maintaining no prefix tree; and from GenMol by performing no fragment remasking or reverse diffusion. method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the root succeeds, change only its social communication topology: replace attraction to the all-swarm best and historical all-swarm best with attraction to the best personal-best position in each particle's fixed ring neighborhood, while keeping the autoencoder, persistent velocities, cognitive term, and direct decoding loop fixed. If the molecular latent swarm is collapsing onto one decoded basin, slower propagation of an early winner should preserve independent searches long enough to increase the chance of a stronger final Top-1 within the remaining feedback rounds; latent swarm spread and distinct decoded chemotypes would be activation evidence only, not substitute objectives.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic sequence-to-sequence molecular autoencoder on randomized and canonicalized SMILES views of the allowed unlabeled corpus, then freeze its encoder and decoder. At the start of each independent objective session, encode the ten fixed scored initial molecules as ten persistent particles with latent velocities and personal-best memories. After every oracle response, update the personal and swarm-best memories, move each particle by the Molecular Swarm Optimization rule combining inertia with stochastic attraction toward its own best and the swarm's current and historical best positions, and decode one fresh valid unique molecule from each resulting trajectory for the next announced batch. L16.method_thesis: A corpus-only canonical-SMILES language model supplies both a frozen generative prior and a frozen sequence embedding; each objective then fits an exact probabilistic surrogate to all real task-local observations, updates a persistent anchor only with true rewards, trains a disposable anchor clone only with surrogate posterior-mean rewards, ancestrally generates a fresh ephemeral pool from that shifted clone, and selects the announced batch by sequential expected improvement. The acyclic graph is one time-unrolled online transition: selected molecules are scored by the external evaluator, and that observe message re-enters the surrogate and true-anchor Layers on the next transition until the fixed budget ends.
